summary: Rewrote the makefiles (generated version.h and ops.h in build/gen, dependency tracking, config stamp for DEBUG, static link order, failing check, install and qs.pc handling), removed the stale hand-written include/qs/ops.h, and fixed all warnings in the code without changing behavior (including the prefix-minus precedence rule, signed index check in colstat and fall-through in size parsing). Verified clean-tree builds of every target at -j8, check, DEBUG=1, install into a DESTDIR, and incremental rebuilds.
